method: Embedded images were extracted with poppler pdfimages. They are raster XObjects, not vector curve paths; rendering the page at a higher DPI would only interpolate the same pixels. Axis values come from Tesseract OCR plus geometric tick pairing. Minus signs dropped by OCR are restored only by the documented zero-anchor rule. Curve ink is traced from the OCR channel label. Failed traces stay insufficient.
